## Myeloid subsets


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```
:::


### Pseudobulk


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
so_b2m_M <- subset(so_M %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_b2m_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_b2m_M,
    metadata = so_b2m_M@meta.data %>%
        mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
        select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
get_metadata_from_so(so_b2m_M) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_M_subtypes", label = T)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](13_pb-and-sc_comparing_CD40_and_isotype_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
so_b2m_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_b2m_M,
    metadata = so_b2m_M@meta.data %>%
      mutate(general_M_subtypes_grouped = case_when(
        general_M_subtypes %in% c("MDSC", "Proliferating", "Macrophages", "Monocytes") ~ "Mac/mono", 
        TRUE ~ general_M_subtypes
      )) %>% 
      dplyr::select(general_M_subtypes_grouped)
)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
out <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "pb_b2m_Mgrouped.rds"),
  function() {
    pb_list <-
      make_pseudobulk(so_b2m_M, "general_M_subtypes_grouped", "mouse_no_underscore", "treatment")
    deseq_list <-
      map(pb_list,
          ~ pb_to_deseq(..1, sample_var = "general_M_subtypes_grouped", vars = "treatment"))
    rlog_list <-
      map(deseq_list, rlog, blind = TRUE)
    return(list(pb_list, deseq_list, rlog_list))
  }
)

pb_list <- out[[1]]
deseq_list <- out[[2]]
rlog_list <- out[[3]]
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
norm_counts <- counts(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`, normalized = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
saveRDS(norm_counts, file.path(results_dir, "pb_iso_macs_norm_counts.rds"))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
  datatable()
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pb_dge_df <- results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") 
write_tsv(pb_dge_df, file.path(results_dir, "dge_pb_b2m_macs_cd40.v.iso.tsv"))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pb_dge_df %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  head(10)
```

#### Heatmap visualization of mac/mono only


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dge_cd40.v.iso <- pb_dge_df

topn <- 100
top_n_genes <- dge_cd40.v.iso %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
bot_n_genes <- dge_cd40.v.iso %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
h_mtx <- norm_counts %>% 
  filter(gene %in% top_n_genes | gene %in% bot_n_genes) %>% 
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c(top_n_genes, rev(bot_n_genes)))) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()
Heatmap(h_mtx, 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        name = "scaled expr.",
        show_row_names = FALSE)
```
